# CANDIDATE: VIX_INTRADAY_MEAN_REV_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Intraday spikes in VIX often revert, dragging SPY lower when price is above VWAP, offering a short edge. The strategy captures mean reversion in VIX while SPY exhibits intraday strength above its VWAP, expecting a short-term pullback.

## Mechanism

Entry: When the 1‑minute VIX exceeds its 20‑period VWAP by 1.5× its ATR (using VIX ATR) AND SPY price is above its 5‑minute VWAP, enter a short at the close of that VIX spike bar. Exit: Initial stop placed at the recent swing high (prior HH) or 1×ATR above entry; target set at the SPY VWAP level. If price moves favorably, trail the stop with a chandelier exit (ATR×2). Regime filter: only trade when VIX < 20 and avoid when SPY is in a strong uptrend ribbon (steep upward slope of EMA ribbon).
